timestamp_semantics: monotonic logical append time after Campaign200 authority verification and the bounded Campaign201 adjacent-frontier audit
purpose: Freeze a finite issuer-as-healthcare-provider referral, appointment, waitlist, authorization, admission, care-episode, procedure, discharge, readmission, provider-claim and reimbursement lifecycle before source rows, patient or claim values, formulas, directions, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.bounded_search_scope: Campaign160 inventory and Campaign163-200 source-frontier metadata only
repository_evidence.clinical_trial_boundary: Campaign190 freezes investigational trial design, enrollment, endpoint readout and safety review. Routine provider care episodes, admissions, procedures, discharges and payer claims cannot be populated from sponsor trial histories, approval events or R&D milestones.
repository_evidence.operating_kpi_boundary: Campaign168 freezes recurring customer counts, site footprint, utilization and service volume. Aggregate patient visits, admissions, occupied beds, procedures or facility counts do not preserve referral-to-discharge episode transitions, cancellations, transfers, readmissions or claim adjudication.
repository_evidence.customer_quality_and_support_boundary: Campaign170 freezes complaints, satisfaction, returns and retention outcomes, while Campaign199 freezes support-ticket stock flow and SLA clocks. Patient satisfaction, complaint handling or a service desk ticket cannot substitute for clinical encounter, care-pathway, discharge and payer-claim identities.
repository_evidence.insurer_claims_boundary: Campaign189 freezes the insurer's insured exposure, claim incidence, severity, reserves and reinsurance state. Campaign201 is limited to the healthcare provider's eligibility, authorization, coding, submission, denial, appeal and reimbursement workflow; insurer underwriting or reserve outcomes cannot substitute for it.
repository_evidence.pricing_and_payment_processing_boundary: Campaign169 freezes service prices, tariffs and reimbursement rates, while Campaign195 freezes merchant authorization, clearing and settlement rails. A tariff, bill amount, card payment, receivable or cash settlement does not establish that a care episode was authorized, delivered, coded, adjudicated and reimbursed.
repository_evidence.incident_milestone_license_boundary: A medical accident, safety event, disciplinary action, license approval, hospital opening or single procedure milestone belongs to terminal incident, milestone or operating-license domains unless a complete recurring provider-care population is separately admitted.
repository_evidence.privacy_and_lawful_use_boundary: No protected health information, directly identifiable patient record, confidential medical chart or unlawfully obtained claim record may be acquired or used. Any admitted source must be lawful, licensed or public, deidentified and aggregate enough to avoid re-identification while preserving the frozen point-in-time issuer-state contract.
repository_evidence.accounting_and_market_boundary: Medical-service revenue, receivables, contract assets, bad-debt expense, provisions, cash flow or security-price paths are accounting or market outcomes unless bound to stable provider, episode, authorization and claim histories.
repository_evidence.sector_scope_boundary: Applicable hospital, clinic, dental, dialysis, rehabilitation and other care-delivery issuers must be frozen point in time. Drug developers, insurers, distributors, device makers and structurally inapplicable issuers may not be filled with zero or cross-sector ranked.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current hospital roster, patient registry, diagnosis, discharge or claim status cannot be projected backward without the full lawful event, correction, cancellation, denial, appeal, payment and first-public or first-licensed-availability history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted lawful point-in-time source freezes provider site, patient or deidentified episode, referral, appointment, payer-plan and authorization identities; waitlist and scheduling transitions; cancellations, no-shows and transfers; corrections and first-available timing; and the complete 2019-2023 applicable denominator.

finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a lawful deidentified source with stable encounter and care-episode linkage, diagnosis and procedure code versions, capacity denominators, transfer and discharge rules, readmission windows, revisions, first-available timing and a complete population including aborted, transferred, adverse and unresolved episodes.
